In addition to improving the plot model, we also added the "empire model" during the year. Players of this model will be able to form real gangs, recruit various levels of thugs, develop their own gang leaders (skills, characteristics, attributes, etc.), manipulate gang leaders and younger brothers to capture the city's main street locations and eliminate aliens.
